body:
I'm not sure how useful this test is, since reference types are sorted by pointer or `ObjectID`. I was thinking of checking the sorting priority: first by instance, and if they're equal, then by method name. It would be nice if we could come up with such a test. But if it's too complicated, I think we can leave it as is.

**EDIT:** On the other hand, we always compare the hash first, so the sorting priority doesn't matter (it only works in case of content equality or hash collision).

You're right, so I kept a simpler consistency check (exactly one direction is less-than)
shouldn't hurt and it caught the doctest issue at least
 Happy to drop it if you'd prefer

```suggestion
		return vca->variant < vcb->variant;
```

* I'm not sure we can achieve stable sorting at this time, see #58878.
